multi_entity_note: Two parties: JingWei HengTong Technology (ShenZhen) Co., Ltd. (licensor) and ShenZhen JingWei Communication Co., Ltd. (licensee), with separate addresses.
processing_note: Party B shall pay the license fee to the account designated by Party A before December 31 each year.

contract.document_name.rationale: The contract is titled and calls itself the Intellectual Property Agreement, repeated in page footers.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is entered into in ShenZhen on February 08, 2007.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Section 6.1: executed as of the date first set forth above (February 08, 2007) and effective simultaneously.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The term is five (5) years; no expiration date is stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 12: governed by the laws of PRC; other mentions are incorporation, territory, addresses or arbitration.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Extension only by written agreement with a term to be decided by consultation; no renewal length stated.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal mechanism, so no notice period to prevent renewal.
